replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, Dark Senex, has been denied from testing for the Avicus Network.

To Improve your map, the map developers suggest you add more platforms. Currenty, the map looks as if there isn't much space to pvp. There is a giant void gap and we think it's too simple.

If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, Find me on TeamSpeak or Message me on Skype (Sethskye).


You May resubmit your map once edited.
